We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we appreciate the updated forecast for part:360030 and your willingness to commit to a 24-month contract. 

Your proposed prices are unfortunately well below what is feasible for us, but we hope this significant concession demonstrates our commitment to developing our partnership. In response to this additional volume and the extended term, we can reduce our price to a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you very much for reaching out to us again. We appreciate your revised offers and the movement shown in your pricing. It is always a pleasure working with you, and we remain very keen to support your business with our extensive product range and dedicated service.

To help bridge the gap, we are prepared to further reduce our price to €5.38 for the 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We believe this represents a fair and sustainable basis for our continued partnership. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
